subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: i came to dhaka this morning i sent you a telegram before starting from home he said did you receive it in time he asked no i replied Part—B: Writing (Marks—40)
guide_solution: Punctuation and capitalization: "I came to Dhaka this morning. I sent you a telegram before starting from home," he said. "Did you receive it in time?" he asked. "No," I replied. ●Note: For writing part solution, see the folder name ‘Writing Part’ in Google drive.
